mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.com_id AS comId, w.work_name AS fileName, w.user_code AS userCode, CASE WHEN COUNT(j.id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS isAssignJudge, GROUP_CONCAT(u.name ORDER BY u.name SEPARATOR ',') AS judges FROM work w LEFT JOIN judge j ON j.com_id = w.com_id AND j.user_code = w.user_code LEFT JOIN user u ON u.code = j.judge_code WHERE w.com_id = #{comId} GROUP BY w.id, w.com_id, w.work_name, w.user_code ORDER BY w.id DESC

SELECT c.id AS id, c.name AS name, c.reg_begin_time AS beginTime, c.review_end_time AS endTime, c.introduce AS introduce, COALESCE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.review_settings, CONCAT('$."', CAST(u.dep_id AS CHAR), '"'))), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.review_settings, '$.0')) ) AS reviewer, CASE WHEN NOW() > c.review_end_time THEN '已结束' WHEN NOW() < c.reg_begin_time THEN '未开始' ELSE '进行中' END AS status, COALESCE(t.regNum, 0) AS regNum, COALESCE(w.subNum, 0) AS subNum, COALESCE(r.revNum, 0) AS revNum FROM competition c LEFT JOIN user u ON u.code = c.user_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT com_id, COUNT(*) AS regNum FROM team GROUP BY com_id) t ON t.com_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT com_id, COUNT(*) AS subNum FROM work GROUP BY com_id) w ON w.com_id = c.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT com_id, COUNT(*) AS revNum FROM review WHERE review_code IS NOT NULL AND review_code <> '' GROUP BY com_id) r ON r.com_id = c.id ORDER BY c.id DESC
